title: Java 变量
problem_statement_md:
给定的代码尝试输出一辆车的属性，但有些地方是错误的。

请修复代码并正确输出属性。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given code which outputs the properties of a vehicle, but something is wrong.

[b]Task[/b]
Fix the code to print the properties.

[b]Output
[/b]Name: Toyota
Engine: 4.7
Year: 2019

[note]Note carefully the types of variables. Change them to the appropriate type.[/note]
hint_md: 请仔细注意变量的类型，改为正确的变量类型。
